messages:
elena (product): Quick heads-up: MultiToolFlow is GA for Hosted API as of next Wednesday.

mike (eng): This combines streaming + tool-calling orchestration in one endpoint, right?

elena (product): Yup. One endpoint, /v1/generate/multitool, supports streaming chunks + structured tool invocations. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/multitoolflow :tada:

sarah (eng-runtime): Rolling out canary tomorrow 06:00 PT to 20% of traffic, then 100% on Wed 06:00 PT if no regressions. We'll enable adaptive fallback to toolcall-v1 for older clients.

jay (solutions): What do integrators need to change? SDK bump only or payload changes?

elena (product): SDK bump to 2.7.0 recommended. New payloads support 'tools' array and 'stream_modes': ["tokens","events"]. Backwards compat preserved for simple cases.

mike (eng): Important for runtime teams: cold-start traces will show extra orchestration steps. We added a tracing tag `mtf.variant`. Please watch the routing dashboard during canary.

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary-multitoolflow @ 1918765800

sarah (eng-runtime): Migration checklist in console: - run smoke test harness (link) - confirm latency p50/p95 within 10% - validate evals on 5 prompts.

jay (solutions): Example request posted below.

mike (eng): 
```
POST /v1/generate/multitool
{
  "model": "mosaic-mtf-1",
  "input": "Summarize the email and call the calendar tool",
  "tools": [
    {"name":"calendar","schema":"v1"},
    {"name":"search","schema":"v2"}
  ],
  "stream_mode":"events"
}
```

elena (product): TL;DR: GA next Wed, SDK 2.7.0, canary tomorrow. If your team wants early opt-out from GA roll, DM me or @sarah. Please archive any references to toolcall-v1 deprecation doc after reviewing.

mike (eng): Noted. I'll watch the rollout channel and set alert for regressions.

sarah (eng-runtime): If you hit anything weird, ping #eng-runtime and tag me.

deploy-bot: Canary completed 20% -> 1918765855 :white_check_mark:

elena (product): Thanks everyone! Celebratory stickers later :party_parrot:
